description.zh: 灵骏弹性网卡辅助私网IP（缺省自动分配）。
description.en: The secondary private IP address for the Lingjun ENI. If not specified, the system auto-assigns one.

title.zh: 分配灵骏弹性网卡辅助私网IP

descriptions.zh:
为指定的灵骏弹性网卡申请辅助私网IP。
 - 当PrivateIp字段为空时，自动分配一个辅助私网IP，并返回该IP的唯一标识。
 - 可使用GetLeniPrivateIpAddress或ListLeniPrivateIpAddresses接口查询辅助私网IP的状态是否分配成功。
descriptions.en:
Assign a secondary private IP address to the specified Lingjun Elastic Network Interface (ENI).

- If the PrivateIp field is empty, the system automatically assigns a secondary private IP address and returns its unique identifier.

- You can use the GetLeniPrivateIpAddress or ListLeniPrivateIpAddresses API operations to verify whether the secondary private IP address was assigned successfully.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eflo assign-leni-private-ip-address --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --private-ip-address 10.0.0000 --elastic-network-interface-id leni-12340000 --description Description --client-token 3fd79d62-ab1d-11ec-9a53-0242ac110004 --region cn-hangzhou
